2317-6763-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

2390-6191-8036.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-6191-8036.description:
Gain life.
Christine Chapel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

643-4659-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-4659-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

728-2113-2452-3249--56.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-2452-3249--56.description:
Activate Grimgrin using the abiltiy from Karametra's Favor by tapping them, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the Zombie card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-4184-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3899-4184-6972.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2111-3967-4981.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2653-2893-4826-7941.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Syndicate Liquidators trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Syndicate Liquidators trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

969-2043-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
969-2043-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

81-3457-7791.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

1228-4513.notablePrerequisites:
Gorgon's Head attached to Goblin Sharpshooter.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-4513.description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target creature.
That creature dies from lethal damage due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch ability.
Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for each creature opponents control and whenever an opponent controls a creature.

4681-5170-6798-7452.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

944-1824-2530-7360.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
944-1824-2530-7360.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
God-Pharaoh's Faithful triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

5147-5220-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it triggers. Choose its first mode targeting yourself.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-2557-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4871-5147-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
4871-5147-5220-5946.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1115-3259-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

294-997-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Iron League Steed.
When Iron League Steed dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Iron League Steed enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

511-817-4050-6705-6774.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Frog and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

141-2438-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

1669-3234-3293-4050.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-3234-3293-4050.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
1669-3234-3293-4050.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2173-4050-5220-6538.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1349-2511-4153.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has a coin counter on it.
1349-2511-4153.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Athreos trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter on another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature that died in step 1 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3967-4435-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3967-4435-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2921-5972-6054.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
2921-5972-6054.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

411-2169-4103-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-2169-4103-4613.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {2}.
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-3525-3574-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3525-3574-5902.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3525-3574-5902.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

1116-3188-3240-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3188-3240-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

722-3153-5361.notablePrerequisites: Auton Soldier is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-3153-5361.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

717-858-2894.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
717-858-2894.description:
Attempt to draw a card. The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, causing you to instead discard Nightmare Void. Then, you will mill two cards and return Nightmare Void from your graveyard to your hand due to Nightmare Void's dredge ability.
Bone Miser's third ability triggers, attempting to have you draw a card. The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, causing you to instead discard Nightmare Void. Then, you will mill two cards and return Nightmare Void from your graveyard to your hand due to Nightmare Void's dredge ability.
Repeat step 2.

2232-2506-4031.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" or "Wizard" chosen with Molten Echoes.
You control a Cleric, Rogue and/or Warrior.
2232-2506-4031.description:
Cast Ardent Electromancer by paying {2}{R}.
Ardent Electromancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Ardent Electromancer trigger, adding {R} for each creature in your party.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Ardent Electromancer with haste.
The Ardent Electromancer token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Ardent Electromancer trigger, adding {R} for each creature in your party.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Ardent Electromancer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1021-2034-2345-5310.description:
Sacrifice Bloodghast to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Play Drownyard Temple.
Return Bloodghast to the battlefield.
Use Embodiment of Insight to turn Drownyard Temple into a creature.
Sacrifice Drownyard Temple to Ashnod's Altar.
Repeat.
